the_flag.0x472398: je 0x4723AC    -> bit == 0: take the WITHOUT-history path
the_flag.0x47239A: test edi,edi ; je 0x47232B  -> bit == 1 requires a valid history pointer, else error path

what_this_means: the snapshot preamble carries a FLAG that tells the client whether to use its playerState history
bit == 1 is the DELTA form (history required); bit == 0 is the FULL form (no history)
our bodies take the bit == 0 path - which is consistent with the NULL history we measured
so a NULL history is NOT necessarily an error: it is what a FULL snapshot looks like
that changes the interpretation of the last four rounds: the client is not 'refusing' our history, it is treating our snapshot as a FULL frame
the_open_contradiction: the caller at 0x472268 sets edi = 0xC89A490 (a constant, non-zero) before either branch
yet the argument probe read history = 0 at 0x471980
the ring branch (0x4722A2..0x4722C0) never fired, so edi was not overwritten there
so either the probe reads the argument at a moment when the register differs, or this function is entered at an offset other than 0x472268 - which only single-stepping settles
